text.tspan: Single estimator | SENS_IMU_MODE=1 | one SPI IMU + one UART GNSS | source b798249a
NuttX flat build: shared address space; responsibility boundary, NOT memory protection.
PX4 wq:* workers are NOT NuttX HPWORK / LPWORK; no kernel-worker relay in this IMU path.
TEAL: retained uORB data -> consumer reads. ORANGE DASHED: schedule / wake, NOT inline Run().
GREY: device I/O / call-return, not another worker. Paired arrows separate data and notifications.
A-C: wait -> dequeue -> Run() -> repeat. D: blocking receive loop. uORB is NOT a thread or broker.
B: VehicleIMU integrates; later EKF2 propagates output and predicts / fuses when ready.
Other firmware threads, timers and the work-queue manager are omitted.
GNSS path: independent arrivals, not a global event order
6 UART RX -> NuttX byte buffer -> read/poll wakes GPS task
read on IMU run; NO wake
